# ADR-0034 §2.3 item 10: a fresh setup run can be requested

## Context

The authority half of neomjs/neo-agent-institution#475 (the setup card recovers a run stuck behind an interrupted effect — its fresh-run exit). ADR-0034 §2.3 item 10 (`learn/agentos/decisions/0034-electron-shell-architecture.md`) lists the vessel's setup request shape; #19377 (its amendment for the shared orchestration) names the `fresh` flag as out of scope, "its own amendment". ADR 0005 §6.5 orders the amendment ahead of the implementation in its own PR, and one PR resolves one ticket — hence this leaf. Planner-filed under the FM filing freeze on @neo-fable's proposal (12:55Z); she drafted the hunks, has the broker built on `fable/475-setup-recovery` (c9d6055, no PR), and opens the docs PR.

## The Problem

A run whose record cannot settle — or cannot be read at all — has no sanctioned exit in the vessel's request vocabulary: `setupEvaluate({target})` resumes the record the broker holds, and the ADR says nothing about starting over. The design decision (design seat, 2026-10-03 09:xxZ, on the row's second action): a fresh run is a flag on evaluate, not a seventh capability — no new preload key, no change to the smoke census — because evaluate already creates the first record.

## The Fix (three hunks in item 10, docs only)

a. The `setupEvaluate` bullet becomes `setupEvaluate({target, fresh})` and gains: *"`fresh: true` starts a NEW run for the target, the shell's form of a CLI run that names no run id: the broker binds a new record and answers `{ok: true, evaluation, retiredRunId}`. The run it held stays on disk as history, unread and unchanged — nothing is deleted and no receipt is replayed; what is already in place reads `ok` from the host's own observation. It is the one request a broker still answers when the record it holds cannot be read. The request names no run (the broker's binding is the run), so a fresh run cannot contradict a resume."*

b. Custody: *"a record the broker cannot read refuses every operation but a fresh run."*

c. The item's amendment note names this leaf and neomjs/neo-agent-institution#475.

Facts from the build that the sentences rest on: the vessel's `setupEvaluate` takes no run id (so there is no `fresh`-beside-`runId` case to refuse); `retiredRunId` is `null` when the broker held no run; the fresh record carries NO consents (ADR 0041 §2.7 — consents retire with the proof); the card may prefill the preset and credential path from the retired record when it was readable, and the operator confirms — a renderer convenience, never a consent the record did not receive (design call 12:58Z).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1 The three hunks land in ADR-0034 §2.3 item 10 as docs only, merged ahead of the Institution PR for #475; that PR's body names this leaf.
- [ ] AC-2 The sentences stay at the request-shape level (what the broker answers, what it refuses), no file or symbol names.
- [ ] AC-3 `check-pr-body` passes with one `Resolves` (this leaf).

## Out of Scope

- The implementation (neomjs/neo-agent-institution#475) and the card's wording.
- #19377's own amendment (the shared orchestration), which stands on its own PR.
